title: I Made a Full Documentary in 1 Click (Claude Fable 5 + Higgsfield MCP)
description:
The new Higgsfield MCP combined with Claude Fable 5 allows you to generate full documentaries and playable games from a single prompt! In this video, we explore how this AI agentic workflow sources public domain NASA footage, plans visual beats, generates missing AI shots, and exports a final MP4 entirely on its own using the Higgsfield Supercomputer.

Drop a comment saying 'MCP' to get the full Superprofile setup guide sent directly to your DMs!
